verdict.rationale: Multi-account, cross-provider support is a fair question for an email client like Outlook, so the axis applies. However, the first-party evidence only covers Microsoft Graph mail APIs and never documents adding Gmail, IMAP or other non-Microsoft accounts to Outlook. The community comments mentioning multiple accounts or orgs are anecdotal and do not show that Outlook itself connects and unifies accounts across providers.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place
